newsitem.title: USA: EnergyVision begins business in New England.
newsitem.headline: EnergyVision begins business in New England.

text.p: EnergyVision, a joint venture of Boston Edison Co and Williams Cos Inc, said it began business Monday as an unregulated retail energy and energy services company serving commercial and industrial customers in the six New England states.
The new company said much of its senior management came from Boston Edison, including chief executive David Rosi, sales vice president William Hughes and marketing vice president Thomas Walsh.

One exception is Sheridan A. Glen, vice president of supply and risk management, who previously was responsible for New England Electric System's $200 million annual coal and oil portfolio. In 1994, he initiated a retail gas marketing program at New England Power wherein the company supplied gas to retail marketers in the Northeast, sharing the customer relationship in the process. This program netted the company over $15 million in annual added sales revenue over conventional wholesale sales for for generation plant balancing.
Another exception is Stephen Fabiani, vice president of indirect channels and business, who was previously with KBC Energy Services.
Part of what EnergyVision calls its "unique philosophy" lies in "The Energy Equation", a concept developed and trademarked by the company.

EnergyVision said determines a unique Energy Equation for each customer, which calculates Total Energy Cost based on customer-specific factors. From this equation, EnergyVision provides a customized plan to offer low cost solutions balanced with efficient energy operations.
